ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_ranksigmoid_advantage_rank_blend_weighted_sum
ir.intuition: Shift from margin and logsigmoid link paradigm to a rank-based paradigm using a sigmoid applied to a blend of advantage_gap and delta_rank signals. This loss incorporates a nonlinear blending of rank and advantage signals to capture both ordinal and quality differences. It replaces weighted averaging by summation to increase gradient signal strength and uses a sigmoid link for a probabilistic interpretation of preference correctness.
ir.pseudocode:
score_diff = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
blend = beta * advantage_gap + gamma * delta_rank
x = clamp(score_diff + blend, -20, 20)
prob = sigmoid(x)
loss = (1 - prob) * weight
final_loss = sum(loss)
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    hyper = extra.get('hyperparams', {})
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', hyper.get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', hyper.get('beta', 0.7)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', hyper.get('gamma', 0.3)))

    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_score_diff = ops.mul(alpha, score_diff)
    blend = ops.add(ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap), ops.mul(gamma, delta_rank))
    x = ops.add(scaled_score_diff, blend)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    prob = ops.sigmoid(x)
    one_minus_prob = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(prob), prob)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(one_minus_prob, weight)
    final_loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return final_loss
